    The scalar-weight group W(P) of A₀ (Definition 7.1, Proposition 7.2) #

    weights-and-parameters.tex. For a finite ray category Q, W(Q) = ℤ⟨[r] : r ≠ 0, 1⟩ / ⟨[rs] − [r] − [s] : rs ≠ 0⟩ (def:scalar-weight-group). For P = ray A₀ we use the deck-homogeneous pieces of A₀ as the nonzero rays (Proposition 4.14: each homogeneous ray line lies in one deck degree and the products of the normed basis are the ray products): generators [x, y, g] for the nonzero pieces A₀(x, y)_g, relations [x, z, gh] = [x, y, g] + [y, z, h] when a product of the two pieces is nonzero (WP).

    "Every additive weight on L, with values in any abelian group, is a difference of object values" (Proposition 7.2(2), L_addWeight_eq_diff), from the generic cov_addWeight_eq_diff and Lemma 4.13 (ratio_hyp). For Proposition 7.2(1) see Ψ, Φ below.

    Deviation in Proposition 7.2(1): the deck group of the formalization is the fundamental group of the coned complex (DeckGrading.lean), so the lifted projective category need not be connected. We use the stabilizer H of the component of a base object in place of G = π₁(K); for connected A the paper's argument then gives W(P) ≅ ℤ^{n−1} ⊕ H_ab (Φ ∘ Ψ = 1). Its freeness, needed later, follows: W(P) is finitely generated and embeds in a torsion-free group.
